title: 第十三章 偷天魔功第十四章 天山
slug: 废灵根修炼慢但我长生不死啊
lines: 天上悬挂着两轮弯月，一大一小。
芦苇荡中，李水生坐在租来的两丈小船上，挂上三个灯笼，静静等候。
月照江畔，芦苇荡中闪出两个高大精壮人影。
李水生瞟了一眼，见来人雄壮，身体沉重，便知道是韩虬到了。
韩虬与韩飞踏波而来，落在船头，引得小船晃荡不已。
韩虬面色苍白，长发不羁，身着紧身长袍，威武不凡。
李水生拱手，“见过韩掌门。”
韩虬也是微微一拱手，“前些日子，我前往帝京，在金沙滩与圣火教十二使大战一场，夺得偷天魔功。”
“可惜，他们毕竟人多势众，而且内气古怪无比，让我受了内伤。”
“还请李大夫医治一番。”
李水生伸手搭脉，韩虬体内的内气，好似一汪湖泊，深不见底。
这便是一流高手的内气吗？
两百年功力，果然名不虚传。
但在这一汪湖泊中，却有着一些暗礁般的内气，附着在对方的经脉上。
李水生眉头皱起，“快要侵入心脉了，若是再无法医治，恐怕就只剩下一年的寿命了。”
“可能需要一个月左右，才能治好。”
韩虬大喜，“不怕耗费时间，就怕无法医治，李大夫果然是神医妙手！”
“飞儿，将偷天魔功拿出来。”
李水生道：“我如今已经四十多岁，此物，恐怕对我无用。”
韩虬有些失落，“不知李大夫想要些什么？”
李水生道：“要治好你的伤，要损耗我数年功力，我要十颗天山雪莲子。”
韩虬道：“十颗天山雪莲子实在是太多了，若是只要一两颗，我还有些办法，可十颗，实在是太多了。”
李水生无奈道：“这样吗？”
他摆摆手，“算了，我素来敬仰韩掌门和宋大侠这样的大侠，还请少掌门帮我抄录一番偷天魔功。”
韩飞喜上眉梢，“李大夫果然侠肝义胆，我这就抄录！”
“日后李大夫若是来神锤门，我神锤门必定扫榻相迎！”
李水生面上不动声色，心中却是暗道：师父教我的，果然是至理名言。
李水生当即开始扎针，韩虬体内内气太过雄浑，给他带来的压力也极大。
若不是晋升二流高手成功，恐怕还真没有办法。
三天后，李水生看着面前的两本秘籍，开始细细翻看起来。
“李大夫，我儿抄录的，怕有错漏之处，还请李大夫对照一番。”
李水生翻看了一番，文字倒是没有错漏，只是图画稍许有些瑕疵，当即提笔更改。
他对于人体，可太清楚了。
“韩掌门何苦寻这偷天魔功？”
韩虬低头，欲言又止。
content_en:
There are two crescent moons hanging in the sky, one big and one small.
In the reed marsh, Li Shuisheng sat on a rented two-foot boat, hung three lanterns, and waited quietly.
The moon shines on the bank of the river, and two tall and muscular figures emerge from the reeds.
Li Shuisheng glanced at him and saw that the person who came was majestic and heavy, so he knew that it was Han Qiu who had arrived.
Han Qiu and Han Fei came on the waves and landed on the bow of the boat, causing the boat to sway.
Han Qiu is pale, has unruly long hair, wears a tight-fitting robe, and looks very powerful.
Li Shuisheng raised his hand and said, "I've met Master Han."
Han Qiu also slightly cupped his hand, "A few days ago, I went to the Imperial Capital and had a battle with the twelve envoys of the Holy Fire Sect on the Golden Beach, and won the Heaven Stealing Demonic Art."
"It's a pity that they are outnumbered, and their inner energy is so weird that I suffered internal injuries."
"Please ask Dr. Li to treat me."
Li Shuisheng stretched out his hand to take his pulse. The inner energy in Han Qiu's body was like a lake with no bottom.
Is this the inner energy of a first-rate master?
Two hundred years of skill is indeed well-deserved.
But in this lake, there is some reef-like inner energy attached to the opponent's meridians.
Li Shuisheng frowned, "It's about to invade his heart. If it can't be cured, I may only have one year left to live."
"It may take about a month to be cured."
Han Qiu was overjoyed, "I'm not afraid of wasting time, but I'm afraid of not being able to cure it. Dr. Li is indeed a miraculous doctor!"
"Fei'er, take out the Heaven Stealing Demonic Skill."
Li Shuisheng said: "I am now over forty years old. I'm afraid this thing is of no use to me."
Han Qiu was a little disappointed, "I wonder what Doctor Li wants?"
Li Shuisheng said: "To heal your injury, it will take several years of my skill. I want ten Tianshan Snow Lotus Seeds."
Han Qiu said: "Ten Tianshan Snow Lotus Seeds are really too many. If we only need one or two, I can still find some ways, but ten are really too many."
Li Shuisheng said helplessly: "Is this so?"
He waved his hand and said, "Forget it, I have always admired heroes like Master Han and Master Song, so I would like to ask the Young Master to help me copy some of the Heaven-Stealing Demonic Skills."
Han Fei beamed with joy, "Doctor Li is really brave and heroic, I will copy it right now!"
"If Dr. Li comes to the Divine Hammer Sect in the future, our Divine Hammer Sect will definitely sweep up the couch to welcome him!"
Li Shuisheng's face remained calm, but he secretly thought in his heart: What Master taught me is indeed a wise saying.
Li Shuisheng immediately started to insert acupuncture. The energy in Han Qiu's body was too strong, which put great pressure on him.
If he hadn't succeeded in being promoted to a second-rate master, there might not have been anything he could do.
Three days later, Li Shuisheng looked at the two secret books in front of him and began to read them carefully.
"Doctor Li, my son copied it. I'm afraid there are any errors or omissions, so I would like to ask Dr. Li to compare it."
Li Shuisheng looked through it and found that there were no errors or omissions in the text, but there were some slight flaws in the pictures, so he immediately made changes.
He knows the human body very well.
"Why does Master Han bother to find this heaven-stealing demonic skill?"
Han Qiu lowered his head and stopped talking.
